assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial management for known sick sinus syndrome.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity.
The service is being appealed on medical necessity.
The denial was under Reason Code PR-204.
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and R42.
The CPT code for the 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is 93226.
